subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should OpenClaw make Mattermost channel-history reads a supported, explicitly opt-in public capability under `channels.mattermost.actions.messages`, with Mattermost owning delegated `read` authorization behind a narrow core allowlist?
rationale: The patch appears technically bounded and preserves existing installations by default, but accepting a new persisted capability switch and a core-reviewed authorization exception establishes a durable product and security contract that cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve the bounded opt-in contract
options.body: Accept false-by-default history reads, account-level overrides, and the Mattermost-only delegated `read` gate after final current-base validation.

options.title: Keep the capability plugin-local for now
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a broader provider-read authorization contract or decide the shared message action should not expose Mattermost history reads.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept false-by-default history reads, account-level overrides, and the Mattermost-only delegated `read` gate after final current-base validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the most concrete supplied history for the proposed capability and can answer implementation-boundary questions, though the product decision itself needs an OpenClaw owner.
